metadata.description: Adversarial test-hardening for AI-written code, with mutation-kill receipts.

plugins.name: crucible-harden
plugins.description: Runs crucible's Tester/Critic loop against one module: mutation testing names the defects your suite misses, a Critic writes tests to kill exactly those, and any test that fails on pristine code is discarded rather than banked. Requires `pip install crucible-harden`.
